Welcome to the latest edition of our healthcare newsletter!
Keep reading for all the new healthcare related developments going on at Flywire in September and October, including our participation at this year's Cerner Health Conference and the Becker’s Health IT & Revenue Cycle Conference. Join us at the Cerner Health Conference OCTOBER 13TH - 14TH, 2020
As Cerner's preferred partner for patient financial engagement, schedule time with us at CHC to learn more about how we're joining forces to create a better patient financial experience. Stories from patients. Learnings from providers. Personalization: The key to patient affordability Hear from our senior product manager, Cristobal Leal, on how leveraging machine learning and predictive analytics is critical in solving the affordability crisis for patients.
